changes.new:
memcpy(pw_handle.signature, password, password_length < sizeof(pw_handle.signature) ? password_length : sizeof(pw_handle.signature));
	memcpy(password_handle, &pw_handle, sizeof(pw_handle));

proposed.reason: The re-enrollment flag in the Verify response is computed again from the caller-writable request buffer when the response is built, instead of using the private value taken earlier. A change to the handle version after verification therefore changes the reported flag.
Before the password handle is returned, the leading bytes of the plaintext password are copied over the HMAC signature field. The secret ends up in the output unprotected.
